-- Giai phong so dien thoai 0987654321 neu tai khoan khac dang giu UPDATE users SET phone_number = '0987000000' WHERE phone_number = '0987654321' AND username <> 'admin';
-- Khoi tao hoac cap nhat tai khoan Admin mac dinh -- Username: admin -- BCrypt hash: $2a$10$1KMF5SA.Nud7r4ekIpDipePqM72mQzomV5ZAP9C5eypjlSy2E9poG -- Full name: Quản Trị Viên -- Phone number: 0987654321 -- Role: ADMIN INSERT INTO users (username, full_name, phone_number, password, role, is_deleted, created_at, created_by) VALUES ( 'admin', 'Quản Trị Viên', '0987654321', '$2a$10$1KMF5SA.Nud7r4ekIpDipePqM72mQzomV5ZAP9C5eypjlSy2E9poG', 'ADMIN'::role_enum, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'SYSTEM' ) ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name, phone_number = EXCLUDED.phone_number, password = EXCLUDED.password, role = EXCLUDED.role, is_deleted = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'SYSTEM';
